text:
Aisha Chen: Quick sync 1 Acme pilot wants private VPC deploy with HSM-backed keys for PII. We need product + runtime + infra + security alignment on scope, gates, and owners. Targeting 2024-10-10 (two-week sprint). Who can own what?
Tom Nguyen: I can own runtime changes: model variant selection + quantization profile + trace header. Need expected qps and max seq len to size batching.
Maya Patel: Infra: VPC peering, subnet + route tables, NATing for outbound control. Ballpark 3 infra days for VPC/routing + 1 day for peering auth. Capacity reservation depends on GPU pool lead time.
Jorge Ruiz: Security: HSM (KMS) integration and audit trails required. I'll need a threat model, data residency rules, and key rotation policy from product to start design. Compliance signoff is gating.
Aisha Chen: Acme requires EU-only data-at-rest, HSM keys, and a 99.9% SLA during business hours. They want a canary in eu-west-1 first. I'll send data classification doc.
Priya Singh: Obs/oncall: We'll need tracing (x-rd-trace header) and token-level cost telemetry enabled. Also error budget alerting for p95 latency breaches.
Tom Nguyen: I'll add trace header support and per-request telemetry. Regarding caching: prefix/KV cache gives perf boost but increases memory pressure. Recommend caching off for initial canary.
Aisha Chen: Agreed, start with caching off. We'll enable after canary if stable.
Liam O'Connor: Suggest owners + gating checklist: 
- Owner: Product (Aisha)
- Runtime lead: Tom
- Infra lead: Maya
- Security lead: Jorge
- Obs/oncall: Priya
- Program: Liam
- Gate 1: HSM + KMS integration tested in staging (unit + e2e)
- Gate 2: VPC peering and routes validated with Acme test traffic
- Gate 3: Canary 5% traffic for 48h meeting SLA and error budget
- Rollback: auto-fallback to hosted model variant if p95 > 300ms or errors spike
Maya Patel: Add capacity pin for canary (reserve GPUs). Also note upgrade window: avoid infra maintenance (deploy-bot reminds 2024-10-08 maintenance) during prewarm.
Jorge Ruiz: Also require legal + security compliance signoff before canary. I'll draft the checklist but need the classification doc.
Aisha Chen: Sharing the Acme data classification doc now.
Priya Singh: Capacity target? Acme expects 200 req/s peak initially.
Tom Nguyen: 200 req/s with ~8k tokens avg => need batching + concurrency headroom. Runtime estimate: ~2 mid-size GPUs for canary with 2x headroom.
Maya Patel: I'll request 2 GPUs + 1 hot spare from the on-prem pool. If cloud, need reservation lead time.
Liam O'Connor: Timeline: can we do config + KMS hookup this week and lock in owners tomorrow? If so, 2024-10-10 looks feasible.
Tom Nguyen: Tight but doable if security completes review within 5 days.
Jorge Ruiz: I'll prioritize the review after I get the classification doc.
Aisha Chen: Can everyone ack a 30m sync tomorrow at 11am PT to lock owners and timeline?
Priya Singh: Ack.
Tom Nguyen: Ack.
Maya Patel: Ack.
Jorge Ruiz: Ack.
Liam O'Connor: Ack.
deploy-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance 2024-10-08 02:00-04:00 UTC may overlap with prewarm.
Aisha Chen: Noted. Maya, can we schedule prewarm for 2024-10-09 morning instead?
Maya Patel: Yes, moving prewarm to 2024-10-09 morning to avoid maintenance window.
Aisha Chen: I'll create a follow-up checklist doc and invite the 11am sync. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
